title: GORE-TEX Membrane — waterproof, breathable and windproof performance
claims: GORE-TEX laminates consistently meet a waterproofing standard of over 28,000 mm water column; the membrane is a bi-component expanded polyethylene (ePE) or expanded PTFE layer combined with polyurethane (PU).
Breathability and windproofness are tested in the laboratory using ISO standards, comfort simulations and intensive wear trials; wind cannot get in while perspiration can get out.

Waterproof seam tape complements the laminate to seal stitching and prevent water penetration; the membrane is bonded to outer face textiles and, in many instances, backer textiles to form the laminate.
